groups.defect: The migration indexes execute(...)[0] without checking for empty results, so it crashes when the embed_category or uncategorized_category_id row is missing. The host value interpolated into the INSERT is also unescaped, so a quote or blank line breaks it.
groups.rationale: All four report the same unguarded [0] indexing in lines 9-16. Two of them also report the unescaped INSERT, so the merged comment needs both defects.

groups.defect: The contents of category_fabricator.rb and embeddable_host_fabricator.rb are swapped.
groups.rationale: Both report the same swap, one from each file. The fix needs an edit in both files.

groups.defect: update and destroy dereference a nil result from where(id:).first, causing a 500 instead of a 404. before_validation calls host.sub! on a possibly nil host. record_for_host compares lower(host) against a uri.host that is not downcased, so mixed-case referers are rejected.
groups.rationale: This is an overlap chain. s_8d184fdd shares the nil-lookup defect with s_7958039f and the nil host.sub! defect with s_2a55c64a. s_2a55c64a also reports the case-sensitivity defect that s_5fd8900b and s_5d6ec13d report.
